description.zh: 云手机实例ID列表，一次请求最多查询50个实例的执行结果。
description.en: The IDs of the cloud phone instances. A single request can query the execution results for up to 50 instances.

description.zh: 命令执行ID，根据该ID和云手机实例ID可查询一次命令执行的结果。
description.en: The ID of the command execution. Use this ID and the cloud phone instance ID to query the result of a command execution.

descriptions.zh: 此接口即将下线，推荐使用[DescribeTasks](~~2833926~~)接口查询命令执行进度和结果。
descriptions.en: This operation is being deprecated. Use the [](t2740507.xdita#)operation to query the progress and results of a command execution.
